decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Yuriy Sarantsev was 'born and raised within the Soviet borders' and 'remained deeply committed to the Soviet Union,' supporting 'Soviet Union' as a valid citizenship answer. Document D2 explicitly states he 'was, in every sense of the word, a citizen of this great nation' referring to the 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.' Both documents provide direct textual evidence for distinct citizenship claims regarding the same entity, satisfying the requirement to preserve all valid referents and not collapse multi-answer questions.
